senses.gloss: f. (עָרַף) breaking the neck (of the heifer, Deut. XXI, 4), use of the stem ערף.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 2:5">Meg. II, 5</cite> <he>לעֲרִיפַת העגלה</he> for the ceremony of &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:1:9">Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ</cite> <he>בע׳</he> as regards the ceremony of &c. Ib.ᵈ bot. <he>מקום עֲרִיפָתָהּ וכ׳</he> the place where a heifer has been killed; a. fr.—
Sifré Deut. 306 (ref. to יערף, Deut. XXXII, 2) אין ע׳ אלא הריגה the verb ʿaraf means to kill; Yalk. ib. 942.
